name: 🍳 Cottage Cheese Scramble
tagline: The fluffiest, creamiest scrambled eggs, and cottage cheese is the secret protein boost.

items.name: Sandwich bread or English muffins, toasted

steps.text: Crack the eggs into a bowl, add the cottage cheese and a pinch of salt, and whisk well.
Melt the butter in a nonstick skillet over medium-low.
Add the spinach (if using) and stir 30 seconds until it wilts.
Pour in the eggs. Stir slowly with a spatula, pushing big soft curds to the middle.
Pull the pan off when the eggs still look a little wet; they finish on the plate.
Pepper on top and serve with toast.

kid_jobs.job: Crack the eggs (fish out shells with a shell)
Make the toast and butter it

chef_tip: Low heat and pull them early. Cottage cheese melts into the eggs and keeps them custardy instead of rubbery.
make_ahead: Whisk eggs + cottage cheese the night before and keep covered in the fridge.
leftovers: Wrap leftovers in a tortilla with cheese for a grab-and-go breakfast burrito.
swaps: Egg whites for half the eggs
Jack or cheddar shreds on top
heads_up: Low heat is the whole trick.

game_plan.what: Optional: whisk eggs + cottage cheese, cover, fridge.
Kids crack and whisk the eggs with the cottage cheese.
Toast in. Butter melting in the skillet on medium-low.
Spinach in 30 sec, then eggs; slow, big soft curds.
Pull the pan while eggs look a bit wet. Pepper, toast.
